pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"a reaction happening now to an oil or a skin product: a swelling face, lips or throat, or trouble breathing","say":"Call 911 now. pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":[{"name":"Health form (each guest's own, on the secure page)","when":"before the visit; good for 12 months, with a check for changes at each booking","who":"every guest, a second guest on their own link","result":"the therapist and esthetician read it before starting; not done in time: filled in on the desk's tablet at check-in"},{"name":"A doctor's OK","when":"before massage in some cases the form names (a pregnancy with complications, a recent surgery)","result":"Sam OKs the booking once the guest says they have it"}],"reaction":"a reaction to a product last time: the booking goes to Sam for an OK, and the esthetician uses other products","prep":"for the reminder: arrive 30 minutes early to check in and change; skip retinoids for 3 days before a facial; for a visit at home, a quiet room with space for the table"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the spa: the check-in code at the front desk, one code for a couples booking; at a home or hotel: the code at the door","arrive":"30 minutes early, to check in, finish any form on the desk's tablet and change into a robe; lockers and the quiet room","beforeWork":"each provider reads that guest's health form and asks about pressure before starting","inTurns":"a package runs in order: the couples massage in the couples suite, 10 minutes in the quiet room, then a facial each in two facial rooms; a late start never pushes the next guest","changes":"an add-on (hot stones, a scalp massage) is priced and OK'd before it's done","done":"the check-in code, or DONE from the provider; notes for next time go in the guest's private record"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"a card saved for single services; a 50% deposit for packages, couples and groups (the Couples Escape: $255), counted toward the total; a 25% deposit for a spa party at home, with the rest charged to the saved card at DONE","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form","cancel":"free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting; many spas pick 48 hours for packages and groups)","fees":"late cancel or no-show: $65 for a single service at the spa, $89 for a visit at home; for a package, the deposit may be kept; the owner confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed","refunds":"a full refund if the spa moves or cancels, or a room is out and no swap suits the guest","tips":"on: not included, optional, paid at the desk or on the bill; each tip goes in full to the provider who earned it","giftCards":"gift cards are sold on their own page and kept apart from bookings; taken off at the desk or on the secure page, never through the AI; expiry and fees only as the state's rules allow","memberships":"a monthly membership or a pack of visits, sold on the secure page with its own terms first","tax":"a tax line for products sold, where the state's rules require it","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 applies"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"health answers (pregnancy, injuries, allergies, skin treatments) never go in a text or through the AI: only each guest's secure page and the providers serving that guest; a staff text says only that a note exists","guests":"Rosie never texts a second guest who hasn't said yes; the booker forwards their link, and never sees that guest's answers","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each person's massage or esthetics license per state, where the state's rules require it","skills":"massage (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stones, prenatal) and facials and body treatments; only people with the skill and the license for a part are offered for it","supervision":"students and apprentices work only under a licensed provider, where the state's rules allow","oks":"Sam OKs each group booking of 3 or more guests, a booking with a past product reaction, and a doctor's OK when the form asks for one; every price is on the menu, so no price needs an OK","standIn":"a stand-in needs the same skill and license, and gets the guest's form and notes; a swap is offered only when the guest didn't ask for someone by name; on a couples booking the other therapist is busy, so the stand-in is a third therapist (the example: Iris, who also covers the spa on Saturdays)","away":"only people cleared for work away from the spa are offered for homes, hotels and offices"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"showLicense":"each provider's license number shown in listings, the offer and the confirmation where the state's rules require it","hours":"no massage in hours the state's or city's rules forbid (a switch from the state form), whatever the spa's own hours","away":"massage and facials away from the spa only where the state's rules allow it","minors":"a parent's written consent for a minor, and a parent present for massage, where the state's rules require it","healthData":"each adult gives their own health answers with their own yes (Rosie's rule everywhere); each state's own health-data rules from the state form","giftCards":"gift card expiry and fees only as the state's rules allow","records":"intake forms and visit notes kept with the guest's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks","tips":"tips paid in full to each provider, where the state's rules require it"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"services end on time so the next guest isn't pushed; the full price stands (agreed on the secure page); a rebook moves the deposit with no fee","noShow":"marked 15 minutes after the start, with no word from the guest","standIn":"a therapist out sick: a stand-in with the same skill, when the guest didn't ask by name; or new times, or a free cancel","roomOut":"the couples suite out of service: two rooms side by side with the same people and price, a new time, or a free cancel","formMissing":"a guest's form not done before the visit: filled in on the desk's tablet at check-in","reaction":"a reaction after a visit: aftercare tips, and Sam is told at once","party":"a couples booking or a party: one booking, one check-in code, each guest's own form","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
